description: Fetch the full text of a transcript that someone has shared publicly from RiverScript, given its share link. Use this when the user pastes a riverscript.com/share/... link, or asks about the contents of one, so you can answer questions about the recording, summarise it, pull quotes, or translate it. Works for transcripts and for translations of transcripts.

share_link.description: A RiverScript share link, for example https://riverscript.com/share/abc123. The bare share token on its own is also accepted.

name: get_shared_transcript
title: Get a shared RiverScript transcript
